description: Rename a site, change its entry page, toggle owner email alerts, allow external resources (CDN scripts/styles/images over https), or choose what link previews show. Content changes go through neuron_sites_publish.

cspMode.description: 'strict' (default: same-origin only) or 'external' (also allow https: scripts/styles/images/fonts). Forms and outbound fetches stay blocked either way.

notifyEmail.description: Email org owners/admins about access requests

previewFromPage.description: Link previews (WhatsApp, X, Slack…) show the entry page's own title and description instead of just the site name and who shared it. Visible to anyone holding the link, even without access.

name: neuron_sites_update
title: Update Site Settings
